codeReview.summary: The implementation correctly replaces all .unwrap() calls in swapdata.rs and swapchain.rs with proper Result-based error handling using RendererError. Errors propagate through VulkanFrameCtx, VulkanRenderer, and into katla_app callers which handle them with log::error. The feature description and expectedBehavior are fully met.

issues.description: create_image_view still uses .unwrap() on device.create_image_view(). This is outside the scope of this feature (which targets swapdata.rs and swapchain.rs specifically), but it remains an unwrap call in the swapchain initialization path.

When recreate_transient_textures fails, the error is logged but Ok(Vec::new()) is returned instead of propagating the error. This silently swallows the error from the caller's perspective. The caller in katla_app/application/mod.rs will see Ok(textures) with an empty vec and proceed normally. This is a design choice but could mask transient texture recreation failures during resize.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The RendererError enum already has well-suited variants (SwapchainError, InitializationFailed) that the worker used correctly. No new error variants were needed. This pattern is already documented in katla_gfx/AGENTS.md and error.rs, so no gap.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: katla_gfx/src/error.rs — RendererError::SwapchainError and RendererError::InitializationFailed were used appropriately for semaphore/fence creation (InitializationFailed) and swapchain operations (SwapchainError).

sharedStateObservations.observation: Worker followed the existing error propagation pattern: ? operator within katla_gfx, log::error at the katla_app boundary. This is consistent with the gfx-error-handling-context feature (commit 9a8c59c) that established this pattern.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: katla_app/src/application/renderer.rs:60-63 uses log::error + return; katla_app/src/application/mod.rs:250-255 uses match with log::error + return.

summary: Clean implementation that fully meets the feature requirements. All .unwrap() calls in swapdata.rs and swapchain.rs are replaced with proper Result returns using appropriate RendererError variants. Error propagation follows the established pattern from the gfx-error-handling-context feature. Two non-blocking observations noted: create_image_view still has an unwrap (out of scope), and recreate_transient_textures error is swallowed (returns Ok(Vec::new())).
